meta.name: agent1-deterministic-corpus
meta.author: QA agent1
meta.notes: expect = intentionally planted errors (ruleId match, value match when specified). clean:true rows must yield ZERO issues. forbid hits always count as FP. Extra issues on dirty rows (allowExtra:true) are ignored.

rows.text: Xin chào quý khách
rows.why: leading ASCII spaces at offset 0

rows.text: Cảm ơn bạn đã mua hàng
rows.why: trailing ASCII spaces at end of text

rows.text: Giao hàng  tận nơi
rows.why: double space between words

rows.text: Chúc mừng năm mới
rows.why: leading tab (\s matches tab)

rows.text: Ma don hang	DH123456
rows.why: observation row: mid-text TAB per plan §11.4 regex {2,} is ASCII-space-only and tab is CONTROL_ALLOWED -> expected zero issues; recorded as product question in findings

rows.text: Gia chi con 1000  .
rows.why: double space before dot: same span as MULTIPLE_WHITESPACE, conflict resolver keeps WHITESPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION (specificity tiebreak)

rows.text: Xin chào ,quý khách
rows.why: space before comma AND no space after comma (A,B pattern)

rows.text: Bạn muốn nhận không ?Trả lời ngay
rows.why: space before ? plus ? glued to next word

rows.text: San sale online!!!Chot don ngay!Nhan qua
rows.why: triple bang triggers REPEATED_PUNCTUATION; single bang glued to next word triggers MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION (runs themselves never emit the latter - by design)

rows.text: Ban co muon nhan khong?????
rows.why: five question marks at end

rows.text: Uu dai keo dai den het thang....
rows.why: four dots warn (exactly three would be allowed)

rows.text: Xin chào.Quý khách vui lòng liên hệ
rows.why: sentence dot glued to capital word

rows.text: Lưu ý:Hạn sử dụng in trên bao bì
rows.why: colon glued to next word

rows.text: Gọi ngay;tận hưởng ưu đãi
rows.why: semicolon glued to next word

rows.text: Van phong A.B.C mo cua den 23:59
rows.why: initialism A.B.C needs no spaces; 23:59 is a protected TIME range

rows.text: Truy cap https://a.vn/x?id=10 de dat lich
rows.why: URL with query string is fully protected

rows.text: Xem them tai tendoo.com ngay hom nay
rows.why: bare domain tendoo.com is protected (known TLD)

rows.text: Giam con 10.000d va tra gop 1,5%
rows.why: money 10.000 and decimal 1,5 are NUMBER-protected; dot/comma inside must not warn

rows.text: Hen gap lai 12/10/2026 luc 08:30 nhe
rows.why: date 12/10/2026 and time 08:30 are protected ranges

rows.text: Don hang DH123456 da gui, OTP123 het han
rows.why: transaction/product codes protected; comma properly followed by space; DH token inside code must not hit other word rules

rows.text: Ma xac minh {{otp_code}} co hieu luc 60 giay
rows.why: {{placeholder}} is protected

rows.text: Khuyến mãi đặc biệt​ duy nhất
rows.why: NBSP between words and zero-width space inside text

rows.text: Xin chao cac ban
rows.why: leading NBSP: same span as LEADING_WHITESPACE; conflict resolver keeps NON_BREAKING_SPACE (higher priority)

rows.text: Truy cap https://a.vn/x​id=10 de xem
rows.why: zero-width char INSIDE a protected URL must STILL fire (never suppressed)

rows.text: ﻿Khuyen mai cuoi tuan
rows.why: leading BOM U+FEFF is \s so LEADING_WHITESPACE overlaps, but ZERO_WIDTH_CHARACTER wins the same-span conflict

rows.text: Chuc mung quý khach nam moi
rows.why: mixed-mode trap: only the token quy carries diacritics in NON_ACCENTED mode -> ERROR grouped per token

rows.text: Dat hang nhanh... nhan dia chi trong 2 ngay
rows.why: ellipsis of exactly three dots is allowed; legitimate unaccented Vietnamese in NON_ACCENTED mode

rows.text: Xin chào quý khách, cảm ơn bạn đã tin tưởng Tendoo.
rows.why: fully accented polite sentence must be spotless (linguistic layer included)

rows.text: KH nhan KM danh cho SDT da dang ky
rows.why: whole-token abbreviations under VT_TENDOO

rows.text: KH nhan KM danh cho SDT da dang ky
rows.why: same text under non-Tendoo brand: abbreviation rule must stay disabled

rows.text: KHACH hang mua nhieu qua tang hap dan
rows.why: trap: KHACH starts with KH but whole-token match only -> no abbreviation warning

rows.text: CT TT KM ap dung cho moi DV
rows.why: coverage of remaining abbreviation entries CT/TT/KM/DV
